infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voice messages and calls require microphone access.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is used for photo capture, stories, and video calls.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Media library access is used to send photos and videos from your device.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Contact access is used to show your local phonebook in the contacts screen.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location access is used to share your current and live location in chats.
